_image_hosting: Shopify downloads every image from a public https URL. Upload the JPGs (e.g. Shopify admin > Content > Files) and set image_base_url to the folder URL. image_url builds each URL; {base}/{file} suits Shopify Files (one flat folder), {base}/{handle}/{file} suits a CDN with one folder per product. Leave image_base_url empty to import products without images.

zoro_images._note: url_template must match how your 108-drum script builds Zoro image URLs; {name} = zoro_image_name. Photos are cached in folder as <zoro_no>.jpg, and you can drop files there by hand.
